key_insight: SSH-Net links neural network structure to grouped covariates to predict cause-specific failure-time distributions under competing risks.
engineering_relevance: It is useful for reliability analysis of engineered systems with hierarchical inputs, such as GPU failure prediction, where different structural factors may affect different failure causes.
method: Uses a structured segmented neural network with separate sub-networks for different covariate groups.
Models cause-specific hazards within a competing-risks framework.
Trains with penalized log-likelihood to estimate failure-time distribution functions.
evidence_signal: Performance was validated in simulations using Brier score, AUC, and RMSE, and the method was also demonstrated on Titan GPU failure-time data.
watch_item: The structured architecture may require careful hyperparameter tuning and well-defined covariate grouping to avoid missing important cross-group interactions.
paper_title: SSH-Net: A Deep Neural Network for Predicting Failure Time Distribution Functions under Competing Risks with Application to GPU Data
